cc:Work.dc:title: Opus 5.5 · Species confusion
cc:Work.dc:description: Opus 5.5 · Species confusion. The 15 most frequent actual species cover 308 of 2000 photos. Rows are actual species; columns are predictions. Numbers are photo counts, and color shows each cell's share of its entire row. The diagonal contains correct species identifications. Other predictions includes every output outside the displayed species. Species are selected by photo count, with alphabetical scientific-name tie breaking.
